articles.title: How to choose your size
articles.content: Measure your chest, waist and hips over thin clothing. Compare them with the size chart for your model. In Kazan you can try on two models with a consultant free of charge.

articles.title: Delivery and pickup
articles.content: Pickup in Kazan is free. Centre, 12 Sportivnaya Street, closes at 21:00. Gorki, 28 Pobedy Avenue, closes at 22:00. Check the current status before collecting your order.

secondRevision.contentAppend: Ask in chat to confirm your pickup time.

articles.title: Returns and exchanges
articles.content: A size exchange is available within 14 days of collection if the requested size is in stock. For damage, send the order number and a photo so a specialist can review the case. Payment refunds are processed separately.

articles.title: Your online account
articles.summary: Signing in, restoring access and tracking orders
articles.content: Check the email address and spam folder before requesting a reset. Your account shows the latest confirmed status. A specialist can check delays.

articles.title: Caring for ski clothing
articles.content: Follow the care label. Close the zips and empty the pockets before washing. Use a detergent suitable for membrane garments and dry away from sources of heat.

articles.title: Payment on collection
articles.content: Pay when you collect your order. Select any points to redeem at checkout.

articles.title: Last season’s rewards
articles.content: Check the current reward terms at checkout.
